cost_information_available: TT stores key/depth/score/bound/best_action/generation, not per-action subtree cost. SearchStatistics stores aggregate generation/evaluation/ordering work, not counterfactual action costs. MoveOrderer stores pooled attempt/cutoff frequencies, not beta/depth/cost-conditioned labels.
branching_feature_not_free: Current root legal action list is known, but child out-degree requires the child frontier or a reused previously generated count. Runtime legal cache belongs to current position and restores across pop; it is not a persistent all-child out-degree table. Do not treat paper prior-expanded child counts as current free features.

prefix_swap_saving.assumptions: fixed window, unchanged sibling costs/cut probabilities after previous failures, no sharing/alpha adaptation
prefix_swap_saving.net_condition: extra feature/inference/reordering work H must be less than that saving in the SAME cost unit; caller whole deadline still applies

full_window_root_example.reason: Root searches both actions; alpha tightening changes later child work. A cut-node ratio theorem is not a universal root-order theorem.

cache_conditioning_example.scope: Abstract additive proof discovery with perfect reusable subproof; not current verifier runtime/cost measurement. Same logical action can have different marginal work under a different cache.

censoring: An entered child increments record_attempt before negamax; cancellation may prevent any completed beta-cut outcome. The heuristic ratio can retain that denominator. It is not a completed Bernoulli-failure label or calibrated per-action win probability.
decision: No cost teacher can be trained from one winning PV, a node-count-only certificate or aggregate cutoff counters by calling it a cheapest-cut label. This does not forbid exploratory contextual learning or require exhaustive counterfactual search. A new actual consumer and cheaper observable target could motivate a bounded future test; no implementation/arm/budget extension here.
